name: SIBUR-RT (the former TAIF holding)
via: SIBUR's own site lists its Tatarstan petrochemical stakes as held 'through SIBUR-RT (100%)'
note: Holding through which SIBUR lists its Tatarstan petrochemical stakes (SIBUR's own site menu); SIBUR acquired the TAIF holding, which controlled the same stakes, in the October 2021 merger (Kommersant, 2021-10-04). SIBUR-RT holds 64% of Kazanorgsintez and 83% of Nizhnekamskneftekhim.
